query:
-- Verificar Leonardo no users e allowed_clients
SELECT 
  ac.id AS client_id,
  ac.name,
  ac.email AS email_cadastrado,
  ac.is_active,
  u.email AS email_login,
  u.id AS user_id,
  BINARY ac.email = u.email AS case_match
FROM allowed_clients ac
LEFT JOIN users u ON LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(ac.email)
WHERE ac.id = 3510001;
